objective: Load the frozen old full-model H67 ep35 pickle through the proven H9 compatibility namespaces, normalize it to a passive model_state_dict-only deployment checkpoint, and replace exactly the twelve MLP FC2 weight tensors by their per-output-row symmetric INT8 dequantized values, while exporting the exact INT8 codes, row scales and sum-absolute bounds used by hardware. This isolates the binary-input FC2 proof from the two stage-3 FC1 modules that are absent from the frozen binary-input trace.

quantization.scope: twelve tensors whose state key ends in .mlp.fc2.weight; no FC1, attention, Conv, ATLIF, BN or prediction-head parameter may change
quantization.input_domain: binary for all twelve FC2 modules, proven by 120 records and ten samples in the exact M51 manifest
quantization.scale: max(abs(weight_row))/127, with scale=1 for an all-zero row
quantization.source_checkpoint_container: old full-model pickle loaded only after installing the proven baseline plus H9 overlay import namespaces
quantization.output_checkpoint_container: a passive dictionary with exactly one model_state_dict member; executable full-model pickle is not re-exported
quantization.checkpoint_tensor: INT8 code multiplied by the float64 row scale and cast back to the original tensor dtype
quantization.hardware_payload: INT8 code, float64 row scale and int64 row sumabs

accuracy_gate_after_export.protocol: same frozen H67 ep35 valid825, no-running/current-batch BN, batch size 1, per-frame aggregation and sample order as the admitted baseline
accuracy_gate_after_export.failure_disposition: Do not admit FC2 INT8 deployment, M496 paper metrics, or BN2 bit-tight RTL; retain export as a negative PTQ experiment.

if_accuracy_passes.m496_identity: Use the NPZ INT8 codes as the frozen weight-memory payload for FC2 K1/K8/K1x8 functional, SAIF and PTPX replay.
if_accuracy_passes.m502_scope: Only BN2 receives a strict binary-input INT8 qdot bound from M509. FC1 remains outside this proof unless separately qualified; stage-3 FC1 must use Q24 fallback.
if_accuracy_passes.required_before_rtl: Generate BN2 integer qdot extrema/overflow and address-timed raw write/replay trace, then re-run the M502 16/24 same-bus/same-lane gate.

fail_closed: Do not execute until an independent static reviewer verifies the exporter, target-key selection, frozen identities, atomic publication and claim boundary.
Do not execute concurrently with VCS, DC, Formality, PrimeTime or another project CPU/GPU experiment.
Do not quantize FC1 under this contract; two stage-3 FC1 modules are absent from the M51 binary-input trace.
Do not call the exported checkpoint accurate or deployable before the paired valid825 gate.
Do not place the generated 225-MB-class checkpoint in ordinary Git.
